response.sql: SELECT player_id, SUM(triple) AS total_triples FROM batting_postseason WHERE player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM batting_postseason WHERE league_id = 'NL') AND player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM batting_postseason WHERE round = 'WS') GROUP BY player_id ORDER BY total_triples DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The NL and WS conditions are checked separately, so one player's qualifying records can be different rows. The triple total sums every postseason batting record for that player, whatever its league or round. SUM skips NULL triples, and a player whose triples are all NULL gets a NULL total, which sorts last.
Players tied on total triples at the 10th position are ordered arbitrarily, since the request gives no tie-breaker.
